name: Jacques Lacan
shortBio: French psychoanalyst and psychiatrist whose radical 'return to Freud' integrated structural linguistics and Hegelian dialectics, declaring that 'the unconscious is structured like a language' and articulating the Imaginary, Symbolic, and Real registers.
centralQuestion: How is the human subject constituted through alienation in the specular mirror image, castration in the Symbolic order of language, and unending desire for the impossible Real?

keyWorks.title: Écrits
keyWorks.description: Monumental collection containing 'The Mirror Stage', 'The Agency of the Letter in the Unconscious', and 'The Subversion of the Subject'.

keyWorks.title: The Four Fundamental Concepts of Psychoanalysis (Seminar XI)
keyWorks.description: Explicates the four structural pillars: the unconscious, repetition, the transference, and the drive.

keyWorks.title: The Ethics of Psychoanalysis (Seminar VII)
keyWorks.description: Explores the relationship of desire to the Real, Antigone, and the ethical maxim 'do not cede on your desire'.
